svg.aria-label: Two graphs, regimes (i) and (ii) of Lemma 9.14, of the support g of C along a unit normal, against the direction of the normal from south through east to north. A dashed level L = rho0 - 1/2 marks the shallow lines; the graph dips below it only near the ends, thick blue near the north and thick orange near the south, inside shaded bands of 12 and 25 degrees in regime (i) and of 45 degrees near the south in regime (ii)
